h: Each Soul Receives Its Own Torah Before Redemption

p: when it falls on this Shabbos.
"And all your children shall be taught of Hashem,
and great shall be the peace of your children."
This comes after the prophet said earlier:
הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַרְבִּיץ בַּפּוּךְ אֲבָנַיִךְ וְגוֹמֵר
"Behold, I set your stones in fair colors," etc.,
and all your borders of precious stones,"
as they said in the Gemara and in the Pesikta.
He said that this wealth is not meant
rather, "I speak of those rich in Torah."
"And all your children shall be taught of Hashem":
that is, that they will have learned in their hearts
with the upper tip of the Yud,
which alludes to the Supernal Crown
(as is stated in the holy Zohar);
in all ten attributes in holiness.
It is in the manner of what they said in the Sifrei
which Hashem swore to your fathers
this is the World to Come.
That is, "the days of your children"
means until the end of the generations,
and this indicates the days of Mashiach;
from here the resurrection of the dead is from the Torah."
"As the days of heaven upon the earth":
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּתַב בָּרַמְבַּ״ן וּבַמְּקוּבָּלִים
this is according to what is written in the Ramban and the Kabbalists,
that there will be seven shemitos,
each one of seven thousand years,
that in each shemitah He will renew His world;
and nevertheless there will still be
when everything will be returned to its root.
וְכֵן אָמַר כָּאן עַל לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ
And so it said here about the days of Mashiach:
"And all your children shall be taught of Hashem":
that they will have learned the entire Name Havayah,
which indicates in all ten sefiros.
"And great shall be the peace of your children":
as we have said several times;
that is, that the evil inclination will be cleared out
for this month is the time to rectify,
so that they will be redeemed in Tishrei
And it is connected to this parshah,
שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר רְאֵה אָנֹכִי נוֹתֵן לִפְנֵיכֶם וְגוֹמֵר
where it says, "See, I set before you," etc.,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ אָמַר לִפְנֵיכֶם לְשׁוֹן רַבִּים
and afterward said "before you" in the plural.
that this is what they said (Eruvin 54b):
"What was the order of teaching? etc.
and Moshe taught him his chapter," etc.;
and Moshe taught them their chapter," etc.
And they used precisely the words "his chapter" and "their chapter":
that is, he taught each one
the words of Torah specific to him, to his root;
to the root of his soul in particular.
And this is what it said, "I set before you":
to all of Yisrael in general
Hashem Yisbarach gave the words of Torah;
the words of Torah specific to him,
as it said, "he taught him his chapter."
And the main revelation of the Oral Torah
will be in the days of Mashiach,
as they said in the Midrash
כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁאַתְּ לָמֵד בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
"All the Torah that you learn in this world
הֶבֶל הוּא לִפְנֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הַבָּא
is vanity before the Torah of the World to Come";
and this has been explained several times.
